title: Full open restriction of an unramified moduli diagonal
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F a category over S-schemes, and U,V full open substacks of F [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. If U is contained in V and V has unramified relative diagonal over S [def-weil-unramified-morphism], then U has unramified relative diagonal over S. The diagonal is tested with both scheme projections retained, as in [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack].

source.place: Tag 06N3, full open restriction of the diagonal

proof.text: For scheme-valued functors a,b into U, compose them with the full inclusion into V. The iso-comma categories defining their two-fibre products are equivalent over the base: the inverse lifts each comparison isomorphism through the full inclusion. Full faithfulness lifts each commuting square, and identities and compositions are unchanged. Use the shared fullModuli_isHomLift lemma from the open-substack algebraicity module to preserve and reflect the condition of lying over the identity base arrow.

source.place: Tag 06N3, full open restriction of the diagonal

proof.text: Compose the space equivalence for the diagonal of V with this inverse equivalence. The representing space Z, its map to the product of the two test schemes, and its unramifiedness are unchanged. The first and second projections of the inverse comparison functor are definitionally the original projections, so both required 2-isomorphisms are retained.
